name: Yselle Finchroot
source_profile: ● Yselle Finchroot (NG) is a respected healer who treats travelers regardless of ancestry. Her work has earned considerable goodwill among settlers, although some Thalenweald regard her generosity as misplaced.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 66 (source excerpt; may be partial)
